about: Statistics Sweden table ImmiEmiFlyttN (immigrations and emigrations by country of emigration/immigration, 2000-2024; the 2025 values are from ImmiEmiFlyttNCKM), moves between Sweden and Poland, all citizenships, both sexes and ages. Fetched from the SCB PxWeb API in November 2026. immigration = moved to Sweden from Poland; emigration = moved from Sweden to Poland. The 2025 values are preliminary.
